primary_recommendation: Prioritize teacher target/reference validity rather than seed tuning, more GRPO, or blindly adding overviews.
unresolved_explanations: Part of the late pseudo-fitting damage comes from train self-reference/domain shift.
Even a more transferable predictor can retain the stable typicality/importance mismatch.

evidence_rules: Better development q fit plus better human AP supports self-reference/domain shift as a contributing mechanism.
Better q fit with no human gain, while stable conflicts persist, strengthens the reason to change teacher objective rather than fit it harder.
If intervals include zero or q generalization worsens, keep the distinction unresolved; do not append hyperparameter search.

consistency_engineering_hypothesis_not_v: A single deterministic clip score conditioned on a shared full-video representation, without window-relative position/context inputs, is consistent by construction. Its human usefulness must be tested; adding an overview or label-free offsets alone did not establish it.
